reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides durable cross-session agent memory through local JSON persistence and memory save, recall, list, and forget tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于本地 JSON 文件的跨会话持久化记忆，并通过工具支持记忆的保存、召回、列出和遗忘。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with cross-session persistent memory stored in a local JSON file and tools to save, recall, list, and forget entries.

capabilities: Persists memory entries to a local JSON file
Provides tools to save, recall, list, and forget memory entries
Reads locally stored memory entries with content, tag, and project filters
